plans.core_strategy: CAS claim plan_review inside transaction; materialize subtasks and event atomically; map stale errors to 409
Match death events to current WorkerAttempt by container/worker ID; ignore stale events; respawn same agent role
Scope merge_result context mutation to current merger attempt; remove reconciler auto-commit and fail closed on stale/dirty worktrees
Reserve worker identity and CAS task assignment before external spawn; finalize with container ID; destroy container on finalize failure

conflict_hotspots.reason: Spawn reservation, Docker event matching, and merge attempt scoping all depend on durable WorkerAttempt semantics.
WorkerAttempt lifecycle fields and active uniqueness affect spawn, Docker event, and merge plans.
Spawn identity changes affect role-preserving respawn and tests that inspect fake spawner calls.
Merge attempt scoping may conflict with compatibility RecordSpawn behavior retained by spawn plan.
Stale worktree fail-closed behavior can interact with unrelated reconciler fixes.
Stale-transition error mapping may later be generalized across all gate handlers.

notes: No source files were intentionally modified by this planning pass.
